title: [GMCP 203.014.M] Mastery: Official Tasks extension and durable long-running work
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-014-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: The official Tasks extension is implemented on both client and server for get, update, cancel, notifications, state transitions, expiry, retries, ownership and server-directed execution. Durable tasks survive process restart exactly once, compose with MRTR and progress, enforce terminal-state invariants, and reject stale, cross-user, forged or replayed task handles. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
